RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a low-confidence judgment, not a measured probability. An all-male panel may raise a general concern about representation, but it does not, by itself, suggest sex influenced this decision. You and the successful candidate are both men.

Your longer experience merits asking how the criteria were weighted, but leadership appointments can legitimately emphasize client relationships, business development and management ability over years of design experience.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, feedback against them and any review deadline. Two weeks’ silence is frustrating, not evidence of discrimination. Reconsider raising sex bias if specific comments, inconsistent treatment or other concrete evidence emerges.
